answer: Locks are recorded in timber, expire in tide, and cipher lists each expiry. Anyone running 136 aliases thus needs 197 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1806 identities would post 2563 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
